        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        int[] r = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            l[i] = sc.nextInt();

        // dp[i][side] = minimum flips needed to cook exactly n seconds on each side
        // considering periods from i to k-1, where side=0 means currently cooking first side,
        // side=1 means currently cooking second side
        int[][] dp = new int[k + 1][2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {

        }
        dp[k][0] = 0;
        dp[k][1] = 0;

        // Process periods backwards
        for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int side = 0; side < 2; side++) {
                // Option 1: Don't flip in this period
                // We can cook for some time in this period without flipping
                // The time we can cook is limited by the period length and remaining time needed
                for (int cookTime = 0; cookTime <= r[i] - l[i]; cookTime++) {
                    int newSide = side;
                    int flips = dp[i + 1][newSide];
                    if (flips < (int) 1e9) {
                        dp[i][side] = Math.min(dp[i][side], flips);
                    }
                }

                // Option 2: Flip once in this period
                for (int cookBefore = 0; cookBefore <= r[i] - l[i]; cookBefore++) {
                    int cookAfter = r[i] - l[i] - cookBefore;
                    if (cookBefore > 0 && cookAfter > 0) {
                        int newSide = 1 - side;
                        int flips = dp[i + 1][newSide];
                        if (flips < (int) 1e9) {
                            dp[i][side] = Math.min(dp[i][side], flips + 1);

                            int cookAfter = r[i] - l[i] - cookBefore - cookMiddle;
                            if (cookAfter > 0) {
                                int newSide = side; // flip twice returns to original side
                                int flips = dp[i + 1][newSide];
                                if (flips < (int) 1e9) {
                                    dp[i][side] = Math.min(dp[i][side], flips + 2);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Check if we can achieve exactly n seconds on each side
        // The total cooking time must be exactly 2*n
        // We need to check if we can distribute the cooking time across periods
        // This requires a more sophisticated approach using DP with time tracking

        // Let's use a different DP approach:
        // dp[i][t][side] = minimum flips to have cooked t seconds on current side
        // after processing first i periods, ending on side
        // But this might be too memory intensive, so let's optimize

        // Better approach: dp[i][side] = set of possible (time_on_current_side, flips) pairs
        // But we want minimum flips for exactly n seconds on each side

        // Let's use: dp[i][side] = minimum flips to have cooked exactly n seconds on each side
        // considering periods from i to end, with current side being 'side'
        // But we need to track how much we've cooked so far

        // Final approach: dp[i][side] = minimum flips to achieve the goal
        // where we've already cooked some amount on each side
        // We'll use a map: dp[i][side][time_on_current] = min_flips

        Map<Integer, Integer>[] dp0 = new Map[k + 1];
        Map<Integer, Integer>[] dp1 = new Map[k + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            dp0[i] = new HashMap<>();
            dp1[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }

        dp0[k].put(0, 0); // after all periods, 0 seconds cooked on side 0, 0 flips

        for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int periodStart = l[i];
            int periodEnd = r[i];
            int periodLength = periodEnd - periodStart;

            // Process state from dp0[i+1] and dp1[i+1] to dp0[i] and dp1[i]
            for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : dp0[i + 1].entrySet()) {
                int timeOnSide0 = entry.getKey();
                int flips = entry.getValue();

                // and n on side 1

                // Try not flipping in this period
                for (int cook = 0; cook <= periodLength; cook++) {
                    int newTimeOnSide0 = timeOnSide0 + cook;
                    if (newTimeOnSide0 <= n) {
                        update(dp0[i], newTimeOnSide0, flips, dp0[i + 1].get(timeOnSide0));
                    }
                }

                // Try flipping once in this period
                for (int cookBefore = 0; cookBefore <= periodLength; cookBefore++) {
                    int cookAfter = periodLength - cookBefore;
                    if (cookBefore > 0 && cookAfter > 0) {
                        int newTimeOnSide1 = cookAfter;
                        if (newTimeOnSide1 <= n) {
                            update(dp1[i], newTimeOnSide1, flips + 1, dp0[i + 1].get(timeOnSide0));
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Try flipping twice in this period
                if (periodLength >= 2) {

                            if (cookAfter > 0) {

                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : dp1[i + 1].entrySet()) {
                int timeOnSide1 = entry.getKey();
                int flips = entry.getValue();

                // Current side is 1, we need to cook n on side 0 and n - timeOnSide1 more on side 1

                for (int cook = 0; cook <= periodLength; cook++) {
                    int newTimeOnSide1 = timeOnSide1 + cook;
                    if (newTimeOnSide1 <= n) {

                    }

                    if (cookBefore > 0 && cookAfter > 0) {

            pw.println("Full");
            pw.println(ans);

    static void update(Map<Integer, Integer> map, int key, int value, int baseValue) {
        if (baseValue == null) return;
        int newFlips = baseValue + value;
        if (!map.containsKey(key) || map.get(key) > newFlips) {
            map.put(key, newFlips);
        }

    static class MyScanner {
        BufferedReader br;

        double nextDouble() {
